ops.title: Read every PR check context before reporting pass
ops.description: Owner: rerun-reads-pending implementation owner. Evidence: plugins/long-running/lib/drive/github.py:8 fetches contexts(first: 100), line 60 discards connection metadata, and line 88 reports pass when all returned contexts pass. A queued or failing 101st context is invisible if it was not previously recorded. Next: add pagination or complete per-state counts so an incomplete page cannot produce pass.

ops.text: With 101 contexts, 100 passing and the omitted context queued, watch and status report pending.
With a failing context beyond the first page, watch and status report fail.
Head changes still reset failure history.
